speaker: Doctor
text: Can you tell me exactly when your vomiting started and if the chest pain feels like pressure or a burning sensation? REQUEST TEST: Electrocardiogram (ECG) to rule out heart attack.

speaker: Patient
text: 51-year-old male. The patient presents to the emergency department with persistent, forceful vomiting after consuming a significant amount of alcohol. His medical history includes recent treatment for Lyme disease with doxycycline. Recently, after a prolonged episode of retching, the patient starts to choke and cough forcefully, experiencing chest pain. The patient appears unable to communicate effectively at this point.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Significant for Lyme disease, currently being treated with doxycycline. Social history: Reported alcohol use; found next to an empty bottle of vodka.

speaker: Patient
text: Patient appears toxic and in acute distress, unable to provide a comprehensive review of systems. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Myocardial Infarction presenting with vomiting and chest pain.
